items.title: Vietnamese shop owner charged over fake Gucci, Dior, Hermes eyeglasses
items.summary: VnExpress International reports a shop owner in Vietnam faces criminal charges for selling counterfeit eyewear bearing Gucci, Dior and Hermes trademarks, part of an ongoing wave of Vietnamese enforcement actions against fake-luxury retailers this year. Continuation of the critical-angle counterfeit-enforcement thread distinct from the Can Tho case covered in prior days' pools; flagged here for brand-authenticity-risk tracking in the region.

items.title: Gucci's 'Made in China' Drip sneaker sparks pricing-transparency questions
items.summary: Report details Gucci's Demna-era 'Drip' sneaker being produced and labeled 'Made in China' rather than 'Made in Italy,' yet priced higher in some markets than the Italian-made version; analysts quoted say mixed-origin manufacturing risks confusing consumers about quality and authenticity amid broader discount-driven inventory markdowns of up to 50% over three months. Critical-angle manufacturing/pricing-trust story relevant to price-sensitive Southeast Asian middle-class buyers who increasingly cross-shop or watch China-sourcing debates online.

items.title: Esquire Thailand interviews Gucci ambassador Billkin on investing and identity
items.summary: Thai edition of Esquire runs a lifestyle interview with Gucci Thailand brand ambassador Billkin Putthipong Assaratanakul, photographed in a Gucci Primavera look; focuses on his investment choices and personal life rather than the brand directly but reinforces his ambassador status to Thai readers. Representative activation-adjacent coverage still circulating this week.

items.title: Billkin Entertainment posts Gucci Marina Bay Sands Singapore activation content
items.summary: Official fan/management X account for Thai actor-singer Billkin posts photos tagged #BillkinxGucciLaFamiglia and #GucciMBS from a Gucci Singapore (Marina Bay Sands) event appearance; typical SEA fandom amplification of brand-ambassador activity. Page returned a paywall/access-restricted response on fetch, so no like/repost counts could be retrieved; engagement fields null, magnitude-damped per sentiment rubric as fandom-driven rather than organic commentary.

items.title: Billkin at Gucci Spring/Summer launch event, Marina Bay Sands Singapore
items.summary: Singapore edition of Harper's Bazaar covers Thai ambassador Billkin's styling at a Gucci Spring/Summer collection preview event held at Marina Bay Sands; purely celebratory activation coverage with no critical commentary or visible engagement metrics on the article itself. Logged as SEA regional lifestyle-press activation coverage balancing out the critical-angle items in this pool.

items.title: Elle Indonesia reviews Gucci Primavera FW2026 as a 'new era' under Demna
items.summary: Indonesian edition of Elle runs a largely positive review of Demna's Gucci Primavera Fall/Winter 2026 collection, describing it as marking a new creative era for the house; Indonesian-language consumer-press reception piece with no reader engagement metrics visible. Included as the main Indonesian-market news touchpoint collected this cycle.

items.title: Kering Q3 2026 results due late October; Asia-Pacific softness in focus
items.summary: T1 financial-wire confirmation that Kering's Q3 2026 revenue print is scheduled for later this month, with analysts and regional retail press continuing to flag Asia-Pacific (including Southeast Asia) retail softness as the key swing factor after prior quarters showed regional declines; no new figures yet. Retained as macro context connecting the SEA retail environment to group-level performance ahead of the print.

No reliable aggregate view/like counts are exposed on the discovery page itself, so engagement fields are null; included to document genuine SEA community-generated SNS volume beyond press coverage.
